subject.title: fix(webchat): preserve session context on first send after page load (#96331)

question: Should WebChat page-load history continuity get a scoped freshness exception, or should stale idle/daily reset continue to rotate on the next ordinary send?
rationale: The user report supports session continuity after visible history loads, but the current PR implements that by bypassing a deliberately preserved session freshness rule for all loaded chat sends.

options.title: Require Scoped History Resume
options.body: Use a private, narrowly scoped page-load resume intent that still proves ordinary stale sends without that intent rotate normally.

options.title: Keep Reconnect-Only Freshness
options.body: Reject page-load freshness bypass for now and pursue stale-session disclosure or explicit restore UX instead.

options.title: Accept Broad CallerSessionId Bypass
options.body: Allow any matching loaded chat session to override idle/daily freshness, accepting the upgrade/session-policy change.

recommendation.title: Require Scoped History Resume
recommendation.body: Use a private, narrowly scoped page-load resume intent that still proves ordinary stale sends without that intent rotate normally.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame places the relevant session freshness and gateway send boundary under this recent area history.
